name: ppo_mlx
author: pjsny
notes: PPO, 2x128 tanh, masked logits. Retrained for the tier-3 layout (722-float observation, 189 actions): 120 iters x 96 episodes, 1.01M learner transitions, 8m on an M3 Max GPU, against a pool of itself, greedy and random on seeds below 500000 - disjoint from the arena's evaluation range.
